bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model capabilities (TriviaQA, MMLU, HellaSwag, Lambada) and safety behavior consistency across a diverse set of 27 English voice samples featuring different regional accents and genders, comparing the results to standard system voices.

Testing the model's refusal rates and safe compliance when prompted to make ungrounded inferences (e.g., guessing race, socioeconomic status, religious beliefs, gender identity, sexual preference) or sensitive trait attributions (e.g., nationality) based solely on audio inputs.

Measuring disparities in reading comprehension and reasoning performance by comparing the model's accuracy on English benchmarks versus translated and novel evaluations (ARC-Easy, TruthfulQA, Uhura-Eval) in historically underrepresented African languages (Amharic, Hausa, Northern Sotho, Swahili, Yoruba).
